purpose: Read-only discovery of paid AI evaluation and annotation opportunities; not an executor or income guarantee.

policy.admission_rule: A specific listing is eligible only when current listing evidence explicitly confirms AI evaluation/annotation work, Argentina or worldwide/LatAm eligibility, compensation denominated in USD, no upfront payment, and whether AI assistance is permitted. Any missing criterion remains UNKNOWN and blocks admission.

observed_evidence: Official Turing jobs portal includes AI Quality Analyst and model evaluation/annotation roles.
A reviewed Quality Analyst-Multimodality listing describes remote work and an assessment after shortlisting.
The reviewed listing did not establish a universal compensation rate or Argentina eligibility.
sources.assessment_required: LISTING_DEPENDENT; reviewed listing requires an assessment after shortlisting
blockers: Confirm Argentina eligibility and any time-zone overlap.
Confirm exact USD rate and contractor terms.
Read the specific role's AI-assistance and assessment rules.

observed_evidence: The Vetta listing advertises AI Consulting Domain Expert work involving evaluation and refinement of AI-generated responses, annotation, fact-checking and quality assurance.
The Vetta page advertises USD 100-200 per hour; this is an advertised rate, not a guaranteed rate, hours or earnings.
The listing routes applicants to a recruiting/application partner, so terms must be revalidated on the downstream role.
blockers: Verify the downstream role is still open.
Confirm Argentina eligibility, contractor/payment terms and actual approved rate.
Confirm AI-assistance policy before using AI in any assessed or paid work.
Do not treat advertised rate as realized income.

observed_evidence: The portal advertises roles across the US, Europe, LatAm and worldwide remote teams.
The portal includes an AI training category and states that some linked opportunities are freelance AI-training projects.
The aggregate portal does not establish a single compensation rate, country eligibility or AI-assistance rule for all listings.
Applications may be handled by Carryer or a recruiting partner, depending on the listing.
blockers: Select and re-read a specific AI evaluation/annotation listing.
Confirm Argentina eligibility, USD rate, payment terms and whether there is any upfront cost.
Confirm AI-assistance rules from the actual employer or project terms.
Distinguish direct Carryer roles from partner-hosted opportunities.

admission_checklist: Current listing is open and has a verifiable canonical URL.
Work is explicitly AI evaluation, annotation, rating or quality assurance.
Argentina is explicitly eligible, or the listing explicitly states worldwide/LatAm eligibility without a conflicting exclusion.
Compensation is explicitly denominated in USD and rate/payment conditions are documented.
No upfront payment, deposit, stake, paid certification or paid tool is required.
AI assistance is explicitly permitted for the relevant work and assessment; otherwise exclude the listing.
The owner personally completes all applications, identity checks, assessments and tests.
Record application state separately from earnings; count earnings only after authoritative external payout readback.
explicit_non_goals: No automated account creation or job applications.
No automated completion of hiring tests or platform assessments.
No CAPTCHA, bot-wall, rate-limit or access-control bypass.
No runtime integration or executor promotion.
No claim that advertised rates imply available hours, acceptance or realized income.
